correctness.rationale: For real g>0, invariant hub/uniform-rim plane has eigenvalues 1±sqrt(1+ng²); rim Fourier projectors Q_k have distinct energies 2cos(2πk/n). Collision with λ_- occurs exactly when a negative µ_k obeys ng²=µ_k(µ_k−2), at one k. The finite-spectrum Cesaro formula Mhat=Σ eigenspace F∘F requires fusion at collision, adding αQ_k with α=(1−(1+ng²)^(-1/2))/n>0. Fourier Schur convolution gives baseline rim nonconstant eigenvalues 1/n for odd n and 2/n on even-indexed modes, zero on odd-indexed modes for even n; hub/uniform sector eigenvalues 1 and β. Thus exact spectrum, rank and kernel follow, including antipodal single-mode revival. Independent direct symmetric Hamiltonian diagonalizations/projector squares verified 39 test cases and seven resonances with max eigenvalue comparison error 1.33e−15; numerical evidence is not the proof.
